title: Add SRD source inventory and coverage gate
description:
Problem

The importer can currently pass tests while the source PDF still contains untracked structured content. The latest audit found missing or flattened source structures even though there are no open importer issues.

Examples from the latest audit

- Figurine of Wondrous Power appears in the SRD but is not emitted as magic-item:figurine-of-wondrous-power.
- Avatar of Death and Giant Fly stat blocks appear outside the monster appendix but are not emitted as creature-like records.
- Many named tables are missing as table records or structured child data.
- Class progression tables are not represented.
- Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry table is not represented.
- Subclass descriptions swallow subclass feature text while separate feature records also exist.

Task

Create a deterministic SRD source inventory and coverage gate.

The inventory should scan the vendored SRD PDF text/coordinate artifacts and identify source structures that require accounting:

- major section headings,
- ancestry headings,
- class headings,
- subclass headings,
- feature headings,
- spell headings,
- magic item headings,
- creature/NPC/stat-block headings,
- table captions or table-shaped structures,
- condition headings,
- action headings,
- feat headings,
- trap, disease, poison, and hazard headings,
- embedded stat blocks outside the monster appendix.

For every inventoried source item, the coverage gate should require exactly one of:

1. emitted as a top-level record,
2. emitted as structured child data on a top-level record,
3. intentionally ignored with a stable reason.

Implementation guidance

- Prefer a machine-readable inventory artifact, for example JSON, committed only if it is deterministic and useful for review.
- Include source page, source heading text, inferred kind, and matching record id or ignore reason.
- The coverage check should fail closed when a new source item appears without a mapping.
- Do not rely on fuzzy prose containment as sufficient coverage for structured tables/stat blocks/options.
- It is acceptable to start with conservative heuristics and an explicit allowlist, as long as unaccounted source items fail the check.
- The output should be reviewer-friendly enough to explain why a source item was or was not expected to become a record.

Tests

Add focused tests proving that the inventory detects at least:

- Figurine of Wondrous Power,
- Avatar of Death,
- Giant Fly,
- Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry table,
- at least one class progression table,
- at least one subclass feature heading,
- at least one magic-item option table.

Acceptance criteria

- A new check exists that compares source inventory to generated records.
- The check fails for unaccounted source structures.
- Existing pack verification still passes.
- The current known gaps are visible in the new inventory/coverage output rather than hidden in passing tests.
- No manual content is inserted into records to satisfy the check.
design:
ARCHITECTURE (from 2026-06-11 empirical font-height probe of SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf via extractPdfText):

Font-height tier map (PageText.lineHeights, already exposed by extract.ts):
- h=25.9 chapter titles (25 lines)
- h=18.0 section titles (105)
- h=13.9 subsection headings incl. subclass names (307)
- h=12.0 RECORD-LEAF headings (1398): spell names (e.g. Acid Arrow p114), magic items (Feather Token p221, Figurine of Wondrous Power p221, Bag of Beans p209, Wand of Wonder p249), creatures (Aboleth p261), EMBEDDED STAT BLOCKS (Avatar of Death p218, Giant Fly p222), TABLE CAPTIONS (Draconic Ancestry p5+p44, The Barbarian p8), subclass features (Improved Critical p25)
- h=10.8 sidebar/callout headings (376; e.g. Sacred Plants and Wood p22, Equipment Packs p70) — parseClassCallouts territory
- h=10.0 page-1/2 legal front matter only (11)
- h=9.8 body prose
- h=8.9 TABLE CELLS/HEADERS (2489; e.g. 'd10 Damage Type Gem' rows in Ring of Resistance p237, progression rows p8)

Detectors:
1. Inventory item = line with h>=10.5 (~2211 items). Tier from height. Merge adjacent same-tier wrapped heading lines (extractor only merges h>=14).
2. Caption-less embedded table = maximal run of h~8.9 lines; attach to nearest preceding leaf heading.
3. Structural classification: heading followed by /^(Tiny|Small|Medium|Large|Huge|Gargantuan) .+,/ body line => stat-block; heading followed by 8.9-run => table-caption; else plain heading.
4. inferredKind from containing chapter via existing sections.ts anchors.

Coverage statuses per item: record:<key> | child-of:<key> | ignored:<reasonCode> | known-gap:<beadId>. Anything unmatched => UNACCOUNTED => gate throws (fail closed). Matching: (a) normalized-name auto-match against emitted records, (b) rule-based ignore predicates with stable reason codes (NOT giant per-item lists; e.g. spell-list headers, legal headings, TOC), (c) known-gap rules referencing epic children (4a7.3 tables, 4a7.4 stat blocks, 4a7.6 progression, 4a7.7 ancestry, 4a7.8 figurine).

FILE MAP:
- Create packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventory.ts — pure PageText[] -> SourceInventoryItem[]
- Create packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventoryCoverage.ts — (inventory, records) -> coverage report + SourceInventoryCoverageError
- Modify index.ts runImporter — build inventory + coverage post-parse, throw on UNACCOUNTED, write source-inventory.json + source-coverage.json artifacts
- Modify verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts — regenerate-and-diff the new artifacts
- Modify create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts — include artifacts in bundle reports
- Artifact location: pack dir alongside manifest.json IF pack loader tolerates extra files, else packages/core/data/srd-source-inventory/ (decide at impl; check loadRulesPack strictness)
- Tests: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventory.test.ts + sourceInventoryCoverage.test.ts (fixture PageText), packages/core/test/srdSourceInventoryArtifact.test.ts (committed-artifact sentinels)

Sentinel assertions (committed artifact): Figurine of Wondrous Power => known-gap:eshyra-4a7.8; Avatar of Death + Giant Fly => known-gap:eshyra-4a7.4 (stat-block classified); Draconic Ancestry p5 => table-caption, known-gap:eshyra-4a7.7; The Barbarian p8 => table-caption, known-gap:eshyra-4a7.6; Improved Critical => record:feature:improved-critical; Ring of Resistance embedded d10 table => known-gap:eshyra-4a7.3.

INTEGRATION: reports may flow through srdAudit finding category (new 'unaccounted-source-structure') for bundle visibility, but the HARD gate lives in runImporter. sourceCoverage.ts name-list layer stays (regression net) — this is the structural superset.
notes: IMPORTANT integration constraint (added by Claude review 2026-06-11): this is NOT greenfield. The repo already has a two-layer audit mechanism: packages/core/src/rules/srdAudit.ts implements the audit finding categories (swallowed-feature-heading, class-proficiency-bleed, missing-coverage) and packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceCoverage.ts is the curated SOURCE-truth layer (name lists independent of what the importer emits; see its header comment for the lifecycle/design rationale). The new PDF-derived structural inventory must EXTEND or REPLACE this machinery deliberately — do not build a parallel third coverage system. Natural shape: the inventory becomes a generated source-truth artifact that supersedes/feeds the hand-curated gap lists in sourceCoverage.ts, and the coverage gate reports through the existing srdAudit finding pipeline (new finding category is fine). The current 13 structure-audit findings (12 subclass swallowed-feature + 1 druid proficiency-bleed) are existing srdAudit output, not new discoveries — keep them reproducible. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md including its hard-stop wording.
